description: This file defines API routes for session management in a web application, including listing, creating, retrieving (with messages), updating, deleting sessions, and posting messages within sessions. It interfaces with a Supabase backend for data storage and retrieval, utilizing dependency injection for user authentication, and handles session and message data with detailed access control and validation.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates a Supabase client instance configured with environment variables.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sessions associated with the current user, optionally using an authenticated request.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Creates a new session record for the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed session info along with messages for a specified session ID.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Updates the title of an existing session if provided.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes a specified session associated with the current user.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Stores a user message in a session and generates an assistant response stub.
